revisions.source: Many observers believe that you are too cavalier about the Republican attack machine.
revisions.zh: 许多观察人士认为，你对共和党的攻击机器太不当回事了。

revisions.source: Your own biography always plays well.
revisions.zh: 你的个人经历总能赢得好感。

revisions.source: You've run a couple of ads which have been confusing to voters, more than anything. What do you stand for? What is Bush doing wrong?
revisions.zh: 你投放的几则广告，主要效果似乎是让选民摸不着头脑。你到底主张什么？布什究竟错在哪里？

revisions.source: It never hurts to remind the voters of your time in the military.
revisions.zh: 提醒选民你曾在军中服役，总没有坏处。

revisions.source: It doesn't matter so much how to stack up to Bush -- anything you can do to subliminally convey that you get military matters is helpful.
revisions.zh: 你与布什相比究竟如何，并没有那么重要；只要能潜移默化地让人觉得你懂军事，就有帮助。

revisions.source: Attacking Dan Quayle is a no-brainer. You can't let this terrible choice of running mate go unpunished.
revisions.zh: 攻击丹·奎尔，根本不用多想。选了这么糟糕的搭档，你不能让布什毫无代价地过关。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the selection of John Glenn as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于选择约翰·格伦作为竞选搭档，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: To what extent will you attack George Bush's relationship with Manuel Noriega of Panama?
revisions.zh: 你会在多大程度上攻击乔治·布什与巴拿马的曼努埃尔·诺列加的关系？

revisions.source: I want to see us running ads on TV, criticizing this relationship. Along with Iran-Contra and Dan Quayle, this episode really brings up questions about Bush's competence.
revisions.zh: 我希望我们投放电视广告，批评这种关系。加上伊朗门和丹·奎尔，这件事确实让人怀疑布什的能力。

revisions.source: We'll criticize this as much as anything else about Bush's campaign.
revisions.zh: 我们会像批评布什竞选中的其他问题一样，批评这件事。

revisions.source: This isn't a part of our message in this campaign.
revisions.zh: 这不是我们这次竞选宣传的一部分。

revisions.source: John Glenn has served his home state of Ohio well for many years, and we are proud to have him on our national ticket.
revisions.zh: 约翰·格伦多年来出色地服务于家乡俄亥俄州。他能与我们搭档参加全国大选，我们深感自豪。

revisions.source: Bush is pummeling you with negative ads. It's good to fight back and stabilize things.
revisions.zh: 布什正在用负面广告猛烈攻击你。反击并稳住局面，是好事。

revisions.source: Bush is pummeling you with negative ads. You need to fight back and stabilize things.
revisions.zh: 布什正在用负面广告猛烈攻击你。你需要反击，稳住局面。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the selection of Al Gore as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于选择阿尔·戈尔作为竞选搭档，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Al Gore was the third-highest vote-getter during the Democratic primaries, and we are proud to have him on the ticket to unite our party.
revisions.zh: 阿尔·戈尔在民主党初选中的得票排名第三。他能加入我们的竞选搭档、团结全党，我们深感自豪。

revisions.source: What do you have to say about the selection of Jesse Jackson as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 对于选择杰西·杰克逊作为竞选搭档，你有什么要说的？

revisions.source: Attack ads have developed a habit of showing you and Jesse Jackson shaking hands. Do you have any comment?
revisions.zh: 攻击广告现在常常播放你和杰西·杰克逊握手的画面。你有什么回应？

revisions.source: Jesse Jackson was the second-highest vote-getter during the Democratic primaries, and we are proud to have him on the ticket to unite our party.
revisions.zh: 杰西·杰克逊在民主党初选中的得票排名第二。他能加入我们的竞选搭档、团结全党，我们深感自豪。

revisions.source: I'm proud to stand for election with Jesse Jackson as my running mate. Let the so-called attack ads keep coming.
revisions.zh: 杰西·杰克逊与我搭档参选，我感到自豪。就让那些所谓的攻击广告继续来吧。

revisions.source: These types of attack ads are meant to distract from the real issues in this campaign. We won't dignify them with a response.
revisions.zh: 这类攻击广告，是想转移人们对这场竞选实质问题的注意力。我们不会回应，抬举这种手段。

revisions.source: We will attack the Republican penchant for underhanded racist attacks which they have displayed in this campaign.
revisions.zh: 我们会抨击共和党热衷于卑劣的种族主义攻击。他们在这次竞选中已经暴露了这一点。

revisions.source: Jesse Jackson was a controversial choice, even though he did do well in the primaries. Among other things, Jackson is pretty far to the left, even for a Democrat.
revisions.zh: 选择杰西·杰克逊作搭档很有争议，尽管他在初选中确实表现不错。原因之一是，杰克逊的立场相当偏左，即使按民主党人的标准也是如此。

revisions.source: Jackson's selection was unpopular with some people, but they have to admit that you're a fighter.
revisions.zh: 有些人不喜欢你选择杰克逊，但他们也不得不承认，你敢于斗争。

revisions.source: You had to have known such things were coming. It's not good to let attacks go unanswered.
revisions.zh: 你本该知道，这种事情一定会来。对攻击不作回应，并不好。
